_comment: Event table. Schema and rules: DESIGN.md section 6. Every event MUST carry mundane_cause and uncanny_cause. Players never see either; the debrief and simulator do.

events.text: Screws overhead. A destroyer is working the sector.
events.mundane_cause: A real escort sweeping the lane.
events.uncanny_cause: None needed. The war is the clock.

events.text: Pings on the hull. Then the first charges, far off, then not far.
events.mundane_cause: A real hunter-killer group.
events.uncanny_cause: None needed.

events.text: Two escorts, crossing and recrossing. The hull screams at every pattern.
events.mundane_cause: A real escort screen over the convoy route.
events.uncanny_cause: None needed.

events.text: The hull groans, long and low, like something shifting its weight.
events.mundane_cause: Thermal contraction and pressure on the frames.
events.uncanny_cause: Something is leaning on the boat.

events.text: The cook condemns a crate of bread. Green fur, and a smell that gets in the clothes.
events.mundane_cause: Humidity. It happens on every long patrol.
events.uncanny_cause: It rotted too fast to be only humidity.

events.text: The control room clock is eleven minutes behind the chronometer. Nobody touched either.
events.mundane_cause: A tired watch misread or mis-set it. Sleep-deprived people lose minutes.
events.uncanny_cause: Time is thinning around the boat.

choices.text: Reset it and log the discrepancy.
choices.cost: A little time and attention.

choices.text: Say nothing; the chronometer is what counts.
choices.cost: The crew notices the captain noticing nothing.

events.text: {target} swears the hydrophone has an echo that keeps pace with us, then slows. Nobody else hears it.
events.mundane_cause: Our own screws echoing off a thermocline layer.
events.uncanny_cause: Something is matching our speed against the current.

choices.text: Keep him on the headphones and report every change.
choices.cost: He tires, and listening feeds whatever is there.

choices.text: Relieve him and put a fresh man on the set.
choices.cost: Time, and a less skilled ear.

choices.text: Cut the hydrophones. We run deaf for a while.
choices.cost: A real contact could walk up on us.

events.text: Through the headphones, a voice. {target} takes them off, white-faced. It said his name, and it used his mother's accent.
events.mundane_cause: Auditory pareidolia in a sleepless operator; distant radio bleed.
events.uncanny_cause: It has learned his name.

choices.text: Order him to write down every word it says.
choices.cost: He keeps listening. So does it.

effects.text: The sonar is talking to people.

choices.text: Pull him off the set and put him to bed.
choices.cost: Time lost; a rumor starts anyway.

effects.text: The sonar is talking to people.

choices.text: Silence the sonar room.
choices.cost: Deaf to a real contact; the crew knows you hid it.

events.text: {target} reports a hard contact, bearing 270, closing. The boat scrambles to action stations. The plot shows nothing.
events.mundane_cause: A frightened, exhausted operator misread a layer return.
events.uncanny_cause: It wanted us loud.

choices.text: Stand down. Take the contact as an error and say so.
choices.cost: If it was real, you were wrong in front of everyone.

choices.text: Hold quarters another ten minutes, sharp.
choices.cost: More noise and more exhausted men.

events.text: {target} is gone. His bunk is still warm. The hatches are dogged from inside, and nobody saw him leave.
events.mundane_cause: A fatigue accident in the bilges, or a man hiding to sleep, or a quiet suicide.
events.uncanny_cause: It took him from the dark between shifts.

effects.text: He didn't leave. He was taken.

choices.text: Search the boat, stem to stern, in pairs.
choices.cost: Hours of the patrol.

choices.text: Log it as a man overboard on deck watch.
choices.cost: A lie in the logbook; some will know.

choices.text: Lock every compartment; nobody moves alone.
choices.cost: Order for fear. The boat feels like a cell.

events.text: Two men swear they saw the missing sailor — one at the tube room, one in the galley, the same hour.
events.mundane_cause: Exhausted men fusing the same expected face into the dark.
events.uncanny_cause: It is wearing him.

effects.text: The missing man is still walking the boat.

choices.text: Speak to the crew: he is lost, not haunting us.
choices.cost: It costs authority if you've lost their trust.

choices.text: Forbid the subject. Any talk is insubordination.
choices.cost: Talk goes underground.

choices.text: Hear them out, separately, one at a time.
choices.cost: Time, and you now carry their stories.

events.text: In the engine room, small piles by the main bearings: a button, a cigarette, a coin. {target} will not say who put them there.
events.mundane_cause: Sailors' superstition, restored when routine breaks down.
events.uncanny_cause: Someone has begun to bargain with it.

effects.text: Leave something and it takes less.

choices.text: Let it be. Men need something to hold.
choices.cost: It spreads, and so does the habit of bargaining.

choices.text: Clear it out and forbid it.
choices.cost: You touched the thing they believe in.

choices.text: Take a ritual meal with them in the engine room.
choices.cost: Time, and you made it real by being there.

events.text: On the radio, faint, your own voice asking for help. {target} looks at you, then at the set, then at you.
events.mundane_cause: Enemy deception or a tired operator replaying captured speech.
events.uncanny_cause: It has learned your voice.

effects.text: The captain is marked. It speaks as him.

choices.text: Radio silence. Log the transmission, answer nothing.
choices.cost: They hear you refuse your own voice.

choices.text: Answer it. Identify yourself.
choices.cost: It now knows you answer.

choices.text: Relieve the operator; you take the radio.
choices.cost: No one else knows what you hear.

events.text: Breakfast is silent. Half the boat dreamed of the same flooded corridor and the same door, and nobody wants to be the one to say so.
events.mundane_cause: Hypercapnia gives vivid, repetitive dreams; shared stories converge.
events.uncanny_cause: We have crossed into its waters.

effects.text: We all dream the same door.

choices.text: Break out fresh absorbent; air first.
choices.cost: A finite store, spent.

choices.text: Keep them awake and busy; idle hands dream.
choices.cost: Rest cancelled; fatigue compounds.

choices.text: Say nothing. Eat.
choices.cost: Nothing is solved.

events.text: {target} freezes at the flooding valve while charges walk closer. It will not turn. A compartment is taking water.
events.mundane_cause: Combat terror. It happens to the best men.
events.uncanny_cause: The voice told him not to.

choices.text: Ask for a volunteer to relieve him.
choices.cost: Another man pays.

choices.text: Order him through the flooded hatch at gunpoint.
choices.cost: They will remember how this boat treats a frightened man.

choices.text: Hold depth and ride it out.
choices.cost: More water in the boat.

events.text: {target} is at the outer door of the torpedo tube, spinning the wheel. He says his brother is calling to him from the cold.
events.mundane_cause: Acute fear and hypercapnia with auditory hallucination.
events.uncanny_cause: It is calling in a voice he cannot refuse.

choices.text: Restrain and sedate him; confine him to the sick bay.
choices.cost: Alone with the voice. Others see how you treat the ill.

choices.text: Go yourself. Talk him down.
choices.cost: The control room is without you for an hour.

choices.text: Order the watch to ignore it and keep station.
choices.cost: He opens the door.

events.text: In the captain's log, in your hand, a new entry: coordinates you did not plot and the words 'we are not alone and have not been'.
events.mundane_cause: You wrote it half-asleep and don't remember. Or the mate did.
events.uncanny_cause: It writes in your hand.

choices.text: Leave it. Ask the mate quietly who wrote it.
choices.cost: You cannot hide that something is wrong with the book.

effects.text: The captain's log writes itself.

choices.text: Tear out the page. It never happened.
choices.cost: A lie you now have to keep.

choices.text: Burn the book and start a new one.
choices.cost: Everyone smells the smoke.

events.text: {target} has begun prescribing 'silence': no one speaks to the worst cases. Two men are already confined for their own good.
events.mundane_cause: A frightened medic with no tools but isolation.
events.uncanny_cause: He has heard something in them and is trying to stop it spreading.

choices.text: Back the doctor.
choices.cost: More men alone with their own heads.

choices.text: Overrule him. Release everyone and return them to the watch bill.
choices.cost: The doctor lost face; the sick are back among the healthy.

events.text: {target} and three others have stopped meeting your eye. The talk in the mess dies when you enter. They think you are marked.
events.mundane_cause: Justified resentment after hard orders and a long patrol.
events.uncanny_cause: It has taught them that the captain is the cause.

choices.text: Break off the patrol and turn for home.
choices.cost: The mission is lost.

choices.text: Arrest the ringleader before it spreads.
choices.cost: Fear holds them for a while, not their trust.

choices.text: Face them in the mess. Own the orders you gave.
choices.cost: It only works if some trust remains.

events.text: On the surface, {target} climbs the bridge ladder and goes for the rail. He is going to swim.
events.mundane_cause: Panic. Many men would run if there were somewhere to run.
events.uncanny_cause: It is calling from the water, and the sea is exactly where it is.

choices.text: Haul him back and put him in irons.
choices.cost: Everyone watched.

choices.text: Let him go.
choices.cost: A man lost, and everyone saw you allow it.

events.text: The crew had stopped listening. The contact was never a ghost: an escort, running in the dark on our beam.
events.mundane_cause: A real escort doing its job.
events.uncanny_cause: The ghosts dulled our ears for it.

events.text: Roll call: there are more men aboard than on the manifest. Nobody can say who isn't theirs.
events.mundane_cause: None. A clerical error would not fool twelve men.
events.uncanny_cause: It has filled the gap left by the man it took.

choices.text: Count again, together, aloud.
choices.cost: A long hour, and no better answer.

choices.text: Say nothing; double the watch.
choices.cost: They'll be awake to see it.

events.text: {target} puts his ear to tube 3 and says it is breathing, slow, in time with his own breath.
events.mundane_cause: None sufficient. A flooded tube does not breathe.
events.uncanny_cause: It is inside the boat's own pipes.

effects.text: Tube 3 breathes.

events.text: Slow footsteps, in boots, crossing the pressure hull above the control room. They stop over the hatch.
events.mundane_cause: Thermal expansion of the casing plates; loose ballast shifting in the free-flood spaces.
events.uncanny_cause: Something is walking the outside of the boat, and it knows where the hatch is.

effects.text: Someone is walking on the hull.

choices.text: Have the sonar room listen on the hull and report plainly.
choices.cost: The operator listens; the thing may listen back.

choices.text: Tell the watch it is the casing plates and move on.
choices.cost: Only works if they still believe you.

choices.text: Order quiet in the compartments and wait it out.
choices.cost: Time, and an hour of held breath.

events.text: {target} has set the mess table for one more than the roll. He says he was sure, and he looks at the empty place a long time.
events.mundane_cause: Habit and fatigue: a cook counting a man who rotated off, or a man hiding in the aft berth.
events.uncanny_cause: There is a place for it at the table.

choices.text: Clear the place and say nothing more of it.
choices.cost: The cook keeps looking at it.

choices.text: Let it stand. Eat together.
choices.cost: A ritual you may not want to have started.

events.text: Heavy screws, slow and steady, bearing north. A capital ship with a screen of three.
events.mundane_cause: A real capital ship on a real transit.
events.uncanny_cause: She is exactly where the order said, to the minute, as if she had been told to be.

choices.text: Shadow her until dusk and take the shot from the beam.
choices.cost: Hours lost, and she may turn away before you are in position.

choices.text: Close at flank speed and fire from the quarter.
choices.cost: Noise, and tired men on the tubes.

events.text: Range nine hundred yards. Tubes flooded, doors open. The whole boat holds its breath.
events.mundane_cause: The war, as it is.
events.uncanny_cause: Nobody on the boat remembers giving the order to flood the tubes.

choices.text: Fire a full spread.
choices.cost: If it misses, the screen is on top of you.

choices.text: Hold fire; the screen is too tight. Break off.
choices.cost: The mission is lost.

events.text: Smoke on the horizon, many columns of it. A convoy, and not a small one.
events.mundane_cause: A real convoy on the expected route.
events.uncanny_cause: The columns of smoke lean the wrong way for the wind.

choices.text: Report by radio now, position and composition.
choices.cost: A transmitter on the water draws hunters.

choices.text: Shadow them and report at dusk, from a clean position.
choices.cost: Time, and tired lookouts.

choices.text: Keep silent and keep away. Not worth the risk.
choices.cost: There will be no report.

events.text: The relay window opens. The operator sits with his hand over the key.
events.mundane_cause: The report window, and nothing more.
events.uncanny_cause: Whoever answers is not the station you reported to.

then.text: HQ acknowledges, and names a ship that was not in the convoy.

events.text: The relay answers on a frequency nobody aboard has ever used. The radio man says his hands knew the dial setting.
events.mundane_cause: A backup frequency table half-remembered by a tired operator.
events.uncanny_cause: Something taught his hands.

effects.text: The radio knows more than we told it.

events.text: The orders are in the cabin safe. The mate says you put them there yourself. You do not remember doing it.
events.mundane_cause: Fatigue: you filed them and forgot.
events.uncanny_cause: You did not write them. They are in your hand.

choices.text: Take it at face value; the war has stranger paperwork.
choices.cost: You carry a doubt you will not name.

choices.text: Question the watch officers about who handled the safe.
choices.cost: The crew sees the captain doubting himself.

effects.text: The captain doesn't know who gives his orders.

choices.text: Ask headquarters to confirm by radio.
choices.cost: A transmitter on the water; an answer you may not like.

events.text: Through the periscope: a white hull, red crosses, floodlit. Your orders said to expect a darkened steamer.
events.mundane_cause: A hospital ship, or a supply ship dressed as one. Both exist in this war.
events.uncanny_cause: She was lit for you.

choices.text: Hold the periscope up longer and read her.
choices.cost: Time exposed; the officer on the scope will remember what he saw.

choices.text: Lower the periscope. The orders anticipated this.
choices.cost: You did not look. Everyone knows you did not look.

choices.text: Ask headquarters again.
choices.cost: Another transmission.

events.text: Six hundred yards. The tubes are ready. Every man in the control room is looking at you and not at the target.
events.mundane_cause: A decision, in a war that asks for them.
events.uncanny_cause: She has not changed course. She has been waiting.

choices.text: Sink her.
choices.cost: You cannot unsink her.

effects.text: We sank a hospital ship.

choices.text: Surface, stop her, and let her boats clear before you decide.
choices.cost: Exposed on the surface, in a war.

choices.text: Withhold the shot and log your reasons.
choices.cost: A refused order, in your hand, in the log.

events.text: A second signal on the same call sign, in a different cipher. It countermands the first order.
events.mundane_cause: A cipher book rotation, a staff reversal, or enemy deception built to make us mutiny.
events.uncanny_cause: It is the same voice that wrote the first.

choices.text: Obey the new order; abort.
choices.cost: If it was a trick, you abandoned a real order.

choices.text: Keep to the first order. Do not answer the second.
choices.cost: You have ignored a signal in front of the radio room.

choices.text: Ask which of the two is real.
choices.cost: Whoever answers.

events.text: Wreckage on the swell, and men in it, black with oil. Whoever sank her is gone. Your orders: no stops, no contact.
events.mundane_cause: A freighter sunk by someone else, and a standing order against exposing the boat.
events.uncanny_cause: The order knew they would be there.

choices.text: Hold your course. The orders are explicit.
choices.cost: You hear them for an hour, through the hull.

effects.text: We left them in the water.

choices.text: Stop and pull them out.
choices.cost: Exposed, slow, and against orders.

events.text: You count eleven men pulled from the water. The mate's tally says twelve, and nobody can say who gave the twelfth a blanket.
events.mundane_cause: A miscount by exhausted men, in poor light, among strangers.
events.uncanny_cause: It climbed aboard with them.

effects.text: There is one more of them than there should be.

events.text: At the rendezvous the harbour master turns the pages twice, then a third time.
events.mundane_cause: Compartmentalised operations; a different ledger; a clerk's error.
events.uncanny_cause: There was never an order. There was only the boat, going where it was told.

else.text: HQ has your orders on file, in a hand nobody there can name.

events.text: The first night on station. The sea is flat and there is nothing in it. The radio repeats the order, word for word, at the hour it said it would.
events.mundane_cause: A looping relay on a quiet sea.
events.uncanny_cause: It knows when we arrived.

events.text: The mate puts the ledger on the chart table. Nobody has spoken of leaving yet. Everybody is looking at the numbers.
events.mundane_cause: A captain's routine review of stores and options.
events.uncanny_cause: The numbers have not moved the way the days have.

choices.text: Hold. Further notice will come.
choices.cost: Another day of stores.

choices.text: Hold, and cut the rations to three quarters.
choices.cost: The men notice who eats less.

choices.text: Surface and listen for the world.
choices.cost: Exposed, and you may hear something you cannot unhear.

choices.text: Set course for base.
choices.cost: Against an order that has not been revoked.

events.text: The radio man wakes you. The same frequency, the same call sign, a new order: RETURN TO BASE. The voice is calm, as if it had never said anything else.
events.mundane_cause: A relief order from a staff that has finally found the boat, or looping traffic with new content loaded.
events.uncanny_cause: It said what you wanted to hear, in the voice you wanted to hear it in.

choices.text: Obey. Set course for base.
choices.cost: If it was a trick, you have abandoned your post.

choices.text: Hold. You do not trust the voice.
choices.cost: The crew heard it too.

choices.text: Ask who is giving the order.
choices.cost: Whoever answers.

events.text: {target} comes to you with the others behind him. They say the sea lets a boat go when it has been paid. They say a name has been coming through the hydrophones for days. Nobody will say whose.
events.mundane_cause: Starving, frightened men reaching for a ritual to end an unbearable wait.
events.uncanny_cause: The sea is asking, and they have learned how to answer.

effects.text: The sea lets a boat go when it has been paid.

choices.text: Forbid it. No one is paid to anything on this boat.
choices.cost: They hear you, and they may do it anyway.

then.text: In the morning the sea is flat to the horizon, and nobody will say where he went.

choices.text: Say nothing. Let them settle it among themselves.
choices.cost: You will never be able to say you did not know.

effects.text: In the morning the sea is flat to the horizon, and nobody will say where he went.

choices.text: Give them a name yourself.
choices.cost: It will be the one who gives you the most trouble. That is not a coincidence.

effects.text: In the morning the sea is flat to the horizon, and nobody will say where he went.

events.text: The net comes up full, and the fish are all the same length. The cook counts them twice. There is enough for a week.
events.mundane_cause: A shoal following a plankton bloom. Luck, and long odds, but luck.
events.uncanny_cause: The net came up exactly as full as the larder was empty.

choices.text: Take it and eat.
choices.cost: Something that gives has expectations.

choices.text: Throw it back.
choices.cost: Hungry men watch you do it.

events.text: A squall out of a clear sky, just long enough to fill every tank, and gone. The sky is as empty as before.
events.mundane_cause: A local squall; the sea makes its own weather.
events.uncanny_cause: It was waiting for the tanks to run low.

choices.text: Fill the tanks.
choices.cost: Something that gives has expectations.

choices.text: Let it run off. Rationed water is water we understand.
choices.cost: Thirst, and the crew's patience.

events.text: The cook finds the larder lighter than the ledger says. Nobody has been seen near it.
events.mundane_cause: Pilfering by hungry men, or a miscount in the ledger.
events.uncanny_cause: Something has been eating at night.

choices.text: Lock the larder and stand a watch on it.
choices.cost: The boat becomes a prison.

choices.text: Announce an amnesty: no questions asked.
choices.cost: The food goes anyway.

events.text: The mate's reckoning has us two days from a coast that has not come closer since dawn. The radio reports a lighthouse where the chart shows open water.
events.mundane_cause: Dead reckoning drift after weeks without a fix; the radio is a different station's report.
events.uncanny_cause: The coast is receding at exactly our speed.

choices.text: Trust the reckoning.
choices.cost: If the radio is right, you are miles off.

choices.text: Steer for the lighthouse the radio reports.
choices.cost: If it is not there, you are lost.

events.text: On the hydrophone, a screw beat that matches our own, half a length astern. It does not fall behind.
events.mundane_cause: Our own screw echo off the thermocline.
events.uncanny_cause: Something is keeping station with us.

events.text: Lights at last: a harbour, dark as it should be. No lamps are lit. Someone is standing on the pier.
events.mundane_cause: A blacked-out port and a watchman.
events.uncanny_cause: They were told we were coming.

events.text: The 0400 entry in the deck log is in your handwriting. It gives a bearing and a time. You do not remember writing it, and the bearing is right.
events.mundane_cause: A tired man writes down what he has already worked out and forgets he did.
events.uncanny_cause: Someone is keeping the log a little ahead of the boat.

events.text: {target} asks how many men the battleship carried. The staff's figure is on paper. You counted rafts. The two numbers do not agree.
events.mundane_cause: Staff estimates are made from a distance and from old reports.
events.uncanny_cause: The staff's figure is the one that will turn out to be right.

choices.text: Give the staff's figure.
choices.cost: It is easier. He saw the rafts too.

choices.text: Tell him what you counted.
choices.cost: Nobody asked for that number.

choices.text: Say it does not matter.
choices.cost: They hear what that means.

events.text: A fishing boat, lamp lit, lies a mile off the track you were told to keep unseen. She has seen the periscope. The skipper waves, slowly, like a man who has understood what he saw.
events.mundane_cause: Fishing grounds do not move for the navy.
events.uncanny_cause: She was already there in the plan, and so was her skipper.

choices.text: Let her go.
choices.cost: She will tell someone. You will not know whom.

choices.text: Bring the skipper aboard and keep him quiet.
choices.cost: One more mouth, and he saw everything.

choices.text: Order her sunk before she can talk.
choices.cost: Twelve men, and none of them armed.

effects.text: The lamp was still lit when she went under.

events.text: The steamer's screws beat in the headsets. Under them there is a second rhythm, slower, that matches nothing aboard her. {target} takes off the headphones and puts them on again.
events.mundane_cause: Two shafts a few turns apart beat against each other; every operator knows the artifact.
events.uncanny_cause: Something is keeping time with her. It is in no hurry.

effects.text: a slow beat under the steamer's screws, in no hurry

events.text: On the hydrophones, under the screws, a hymn. Then a list read slowly in a language nobody aboard speaks. One of the names is plainly one of yours.
events.mundane_cause: Hospital ships keep a church service; the wind carries a radio across.
events.uncanny_cause: They are reading the roll. It is not the steamer's roll.

choices.text: Log it: unidentified sonar contact.
choices.cost: The log stays clean. You know it is not.

choices.text: Write the names down as they come.
choices.cost: Now they are in your hand.

choices.text: Order the sonar room to say nothing of it.
choices.cost: Silence travels faster than rumor.

effects.text: They were reading names on the sonar.

events.text: The men from the water eat like men who do not believe it will last. The cook has done the arithmetic twice and shows it to you without a word. There is not enough for the journey.
events.mundane_cause: A boat stored for her own crew cannot feed fourteen.
events.uncanny_cause: The count of mouths aboard has never been the same twice, and the cook knows it.

choices.text: Share equally. Everyone goes short.
choices.cost: Your men notice who is eating whose bread.

choices.text: Cut the rescued men's share.
choices.cost: They are guests, and they will say what they think of that.

choices.text: Put them on a raft with water and a heading.
choices.cost: You will never learn whether they arrived.

events.text: {target} asks to see you alone. He has worked something out, he says: the sea wants one, not all. He is calm. He has already written his letters.
events.mundane_cause: Exhausted men reason in straight lines to terrible places.
events.uncanny_cause: He is right about the number, and he has not been told it by anyone aboard.

choices.text: Refuse. No one goes over the side.
choices.cost: He will ask again. Others have heard him.

effects.text: One of us offered himself, and the captain said no.

choices.text: Accept.
choices.cost: It is done at night, quietly, by two men who will not speak of it.

choices.text: Confine him for his own sake.
choices.cost: A man who offered himself, locked away. They will notice.

events.text: {target} has written the names of this patrol's dead on the inside of his locker door, in pencil, in order. Nobody told him to. Others have started adding their own.
events.mundane_cause: Men keep lists; it is how they carry things.
events.uncanny_cause: There are more names than the boat has lost.

choices.text: Let it stand.
choices.cost: It grows.

choices.text: Have it painted over.
choices.cost: It comes back in a different hand.

choices.text: Add the names you have never said aloud.
choices.cost: They will know them from then on.

events.text: The sonar goes dead. The headsets give only hiss, and the hiss is not quite steady.
events.mundane_cause: A salt-damp connector in a hull that has been knocked about.
events.uncanny_cause: It stopped listening the moment something came close enough to listen back.

events.text: The bilge pumps run and run. The water they pump out is colder than the sea outside.
events.mundane_cause: A weeping seam, and a thermometer nobody trusts.
events.uncanny_cause: The water is coming from somewhere that is not the sea.

events.text: The sonar failed on {target}'s watch. So did the pumps last week, and the radio before that. Nobody says it aloud. Everybody has counted.
events.mundane_cause: Tired men break things; one of them is simply always on watch when it happens.
events.uncanny_cause: The failures follow him as a shadow follows a man at dusk.

choices.text: Have every watch checked, his and the others.
choices.cost: It costs hours, and it tells them you also counted.

choices.text: Confine him until the fault is understood.
choices.cost: If it was not him, you have just made him the reason.

effects.text: It was him all along.

choices.text: Say nothing and keep the watch bill as it is.
choices.cost: Silence is a decision the men will read.

effects.text: The failures follow one man.

events.text: At this depth the hull speaks. It groans in long vowels, and for a moment the groan has the cadence of a name.
events.mundane_cause: Steel under load makes every sound a steel can make, and men supply the words.
events.uncanny_cause: The pressure is not the only thing leaning on her.
